title: Dog Park
description: A hand-drawn 2D sandbox game about being a dog in a dog park. Run around, play fetch, chase squirrels, sniff around, and most importantly, bark at everything. Interact with a cast of weird and wacky dogs, gossip with the local stray cat (how did she get in here?), and watch out for the dogs that really don't want to be bothered. You'll regret getting on their bad side.
description_short: A hand-drawn 2D sandbox game about being a dog in a dog park. Run around, play fetch, chase squirrels, sniff around, and most importantly, bark at everything. Interact with a weird and wacky cast of dogs, gossip with the local stray cat, and keep an eye out for Krebert the Chihuahua. He's vicious.
